limits: Natural-number extents and generations do not model machine integer wraparound or address reuse internals.
Allocation creation/global freshness and unforgeability are not modelled; authorization is conditional on the supplied allocation facts.
Loan admission only checks pairwise compatibility, not validity/liveness of every admitted view or the production ownership checker.
No correspondence theorem to Python, resource IR, Rust or C lowering is established.
No foreign pointer, thread interleaving, hardware or full language proof is asserted.
The pinned executable still relies on its installed Lean runtime and imported standard library as trusted infrastructure.
scope.memory: caller-supplied allocation identity and generation equality, byte ranges, view narrowing and pairwise loan compatibility
scope.types: closed wrapping-u64/boolean/add/equality/conditional expression small-step progress and preservation
